entities.name: Dwarven traders
entities.description: A tribe of land dwarves of Ulgrotha who came from another plane through a subterranean planar gate and ride heart wolves into battle.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: The plane where the dwarven traders live.

entities.name: New Freedom
entities.description: Underground city founded by the dwarven traders in the mountains of Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: Ruler of Sengir's Dark Barony who took control of the Castle of Morning Light and New Freedom.

entities.name: Sengir's Dark Barony
entities.description: The domain of Baron Sengir, which has claimed many dwarven traders.

entities.name: Castle of Morning Light
entities.description: A castle the dwarven traders vow to reclaim from Baron Sengir.

entities.name: Irini
entities.description: A dwarven princess, the most infamous of those lost to Sengir's Dark Barony.

entities.name: Sea dwarves
entities.description: Dwarves who set out across the ocean to start anew; disliked by the dwarven traders but not directly hostile.

entities.name: Grandmother Sengir
entities.description: Traded the Apocalypse Chime to a Dwarven Trader for trinkets.

entities.name: Apocalypse Chime
entities.description: An ominous artifact traded to a dwarven trader with a warning never to ring it.

events.summary: The dwarven traders arrive on Ulgrotha through a planar gate found while excavating.
events.quote: They are originally from a different plane and arrived on Ulgrotha through a stable subterranean planar gate

events.summary: Baron Sengir takes control of the Castle of Morning Light and New Freedom; the traders stay in the mountains vowing to reclaim the castle.
events.quote: They stayed in the mountains when Baron Sengir took control of the Castle of Morning Light and New Freedom, vowing to eventually reclaim the castle.

events.summary: Other dwarves leave to become seafarers, earning the traders' disapproval.
events.quote: other dwarves decided to start anew as seafarers, setting out across the ocean

events.summary: Grandmother Sengir trades the Apocalypse Chime to a Dwarven Trader and warns it must never be rung.
events.quote: Grandmother Sengir has traded away the Apocalypse Chime to a Dwarven Trader for a few trinkets

relations.note: vow to reclaim the castle he took
relations.quote: vowing to eventually reclaim the castle

relations.note: not fond of them but not directly hostile
relations.quote: the two factions are not directly hostile toward one another either
They founded the underground city of New Freedom in the depths of the mountains of Ulgrotha.
